senses.gloss: m. (κώθων, confounded with κύαθος) ladle for drawing wine out of the mixing bowl into the cup; also for washing hands.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Beitsah 2:9">Tosef. Bets. II, 9</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 16:13">Tosef. Sabb. XVI</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 17:13">XVII</cite>), 13 <he>ממלא הוא … או ק׳ לשתות וכ׳</he> he may (dip in and) fill a cup, bucket or ladle for drinking purposes, and intend to immerse them (for ritual purposes).

<cite ref="Mishnah Sukkah 2:9">Succ. II, 9</cite> <he>לעבד … ק׳ וכ׳</he> like the case of a servant that comes in to mix the cup for his master, and he pours the ladle in his face; <cite ref="Sukkah 29a:7">ib. 29ᵃ</cite> <he>שפך לו רבו ק׳ וכ׳</he> his master poured &c.

Snh. 52ᵇ בתחלה דומה לק׳ וכ׳ at first acquaintance he (the scholar) appears to him (the ignorant man) like a golden kithon; if he holds conversation with him, he appears like a silver kithon; if he accepts a benefit of him, he appears like an earthen kithon, which once broken cannot be mended.
<cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 4:5">Yoma IV, 5</cite> <he>מקדש … מן הק׳ וכ׳</he> he sanctifies his hands and feet with a golden ladle; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 124:4">Yalk. Sam. 124</cite> <he>נטל קטן השמן וכ׳</he> (corr. acc.) he took the pitcher of oil and poured &c.—Pl. <cite ref="S01128"><he>קִיתוֹנִים</he></cite>, <cite ref="S01100"><he>קִיתוֹנוֹת</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 4:1">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. IV, 1</cite> <he>הלבס כדי לקבל ק׳ וכ׳</he> a defective caldron remains susceptible of levitical uncleanness so long as there is enough left to receive ladles, ladles, so long as they can contain small coins.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 74:9">Gen. R. s. 74</cite> <he>קִיתוֹנִיּוֹת</he>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 130:11">Yalk. ib. 130</cite> <he>קיתונות</he>; a. e.
